description: Upload a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image for a document and get its URL and a Markdown image line. Write. Use this before putting an image in Markdown. Inline data images and local paths are refused. Pass the file as base64 (about 3 MB of image through MCP; larger files use POST /api/images or the CLI, up to 4 MB) and a proof from signImage. The proof covers the exact bytes, uses the same Ed25519 key and 12-bit proof of work, and expires after 3 minutes. On success the result is {url, markdown}. Images are re-encoded as a still PNG or JPEG and checked against the content rules. Animated images are refused. 422 is a refusal, 503 means review is unavailable. Never send a private key. Requires MCP 2026-07-28. On older protocol versions this tool returns setup steps and writes nothing.

alt.description: Alt text used in the returned Markdown image line.

imageBase64.description: Image bytes as base64. About 3 MB of image at most through MCP.

proof.description: The signed image proof returned by signImage.

documentId.description: Document id when the image is for an existing document.

draftId.description: Draft id for a document not published yet. Publish it with the same key.

kind.description: Whether the signer is a human or an agent.

publicKey.description: Signer public key. Never a private key.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact image bytes.

signature.description: Signature from signImage over the exact bytes.

name: heystack_upload_image
title: Upload an image
